description:
Apply the frozen adoption rules to the profile-selected fusion and M4RI comparison evidence, producing one auditable dense-parity outcome.

## Background

Selection uses confidence-bound allocated whole-consumer benefit, exact parity equivalence, maintenance complexity, and declared dispatch domain. M4RI isolated throughput cannot select an incompatible production route, and the current fused AND-popcount implementation remains when no candidate qualifies.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The decision evaluates each eligible candidate against the predeclared worthwhile-effect, equivalence-margin, complexity, and multiple-comparison rules using only confirmatory evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: At most one bounded production change is selected with its exact dispatch domain and required before/after cells, or a no-adoption outcome preserves the established route and all losing evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing fused AND-popcount and rejected generic carry-save routes remain prior evidence rather than being presented as new optimization work.

## Notes

The decision record is the only authority consumed by the conditional adoption task.
title: Select the dense-parity production outcome
